cats.name: Catcoin
cats.catName: The Catcoin kitten (an unnamed cream-ginger kitten)
cats.whoIsTheCat: CatCoin's mascot is a photo of a cream-ginger kitten with big round dark eyes, set on a gold coin with a ₵ sign. The same logo was used for years by the older BNB Chain CatCoin (CoinGecko 'Catcoin [OLD]'). The kitten's name, owner and photo source have never been published. The community (@catcoin on X since July 2019) moved to Solana in Aug-Sep 2026.

virality.summary: CatCoin is a long-running community brand rather than one viral clip. Its X account @catcoin has posted since 2019 and has 70.8k followers. On 18 Aug 2026 it announced a migration: the old $CAT on BNB Chain and an older Solana $CAT would fold into one new $CATCOIN on Solana (1B supply, 50,000,000 old = 1 new) through Migrate.fun, with a 19-day window and a 90-day late claim. The new token went live on pump.fun on 7 Sep 2026. The project says it reached 100,000+ holders on BNB Chain and won the BNB Chain Meme Innovation Campaign. Its site dresses the kitten as a pinstriped 'God of All Cats' and hands out 'feels good man' stickers in a meme studio.

cats.lore: Catcoin's cat is a cream-ginger kitten with big, round, glossy eyes and a head-tilt that looks like it is waiting for a treat. For years the photo sat on a gold coin with a ₵ sign while cat lovers gathered around it on BNB Chain. In September 2026 the community moved house to Solana and folded its old coins into one new CATCOIN. On catcoin.com the kitten plays dress-up: a pinstripe suit and fedora as the 'God of All Cats', or a sticker that just says 'feels good man'. Same kitten, new home.

cats.name: VCAT
cats.catName: The 'Cat in Guy Fawkes Mask' tabby (the V for Vendetta cat)
cats.whoIsTheCat: A real brown tabby lying on a dark jacket with a white Guy Fawkes mask (the V for Vendetta / Anonymous mask) propped over its face, ears poking up above it. The snapshot circulates as a reaction meme; Imgflip hosts it as the template 'Cat in Guy Fawkes Mask'. The cat's name, owner, home and the photo's date are not publicly known.

virality.summary: The photo joins two old internet icons: cats, and the grinning Guy Fawkes mask that David Lloyd drew for V for Vendetta and that Anonymous protesters adopted in 2008 (Know Your Meme). It survives as an Imgflip meme template ('Cat in Guy Fawkes Mask', also 'Cat in V Mask'). VCAT launched on Flap on Base on 18 Sep 2026 with V's line as its description: 'Beneath this mask there is more than flesh. Beneath this mask there is an idea.' It is paired with Venice's VVV token, a 3% buy/sell tax pays holders in VVV, and its X banner fills a cinema with rows of masked cats.
virality.metrics: No first post or view count is known for the original photo. @VCATBASE: 561 followers (joined X 2026-09-18). GeckoTerminal holders: 1,384; Flap page: 1,395 holders. CoinGecko watchlists: 24. All read 2026-09-25 ~21:10-21:20 UTC (fxtwitter API, GeckoTerminal, Flap, CoinGecko).

cats.lore: Nobody knows this tabby's name. Some time ago a brown striped cat lay on a dark jacket while someone propped a white Guy Fawkes mask over its face: the grin, the curled moustache and the pointed beard of V for Vendetta. Its ears poked up above the mask, its whiskers stuck out below, and the cat simply kept lounging. The internet had a new masked hero. In September 2026 the cat stepped onto Base as VCAT, quoting V himself: 'Beneath this mask there is more than flesh. Beneath this mask there is an idea.' Still anonymous, which is rather the point.

cats.name: ROBINCAT
cats.catName: The Robinhood Pixel Cat (the referral-tab cat in a Robin Hood cap)
cats.whoIsTheCat: The Robinhood Pixel Cat: a pixel-art grey tabby in a green Robin Hood cap with a red feather and a green tunic, standing on the redesigned Referrals tab of the Robinhood app, which appeared around 1 Sep 2026 when Robinhood's new tiered referral offer began. Robinhood owns the character and shared it on X on 3 Sep 2026. ROBINCAT is a fan coin named after it.

virality.summary: On 1 Sep 2026 @RyDawg42 posted a screen recording: 'Did anyone notice the Robinhood Referral tab now has a new look? Introducing the Robinhood Pixel Cat!' It showed the little archer standing in a spotlight marked 'You' above 'Invite your first friend, get $50 of stock'. Two days later @RobinhoodApp quoted it: 'meet your new favorite reason to refer 🐈'. ROBINCAT's first pool had opened on Pons late on 31 Aug; Odaily, citing GMGN, reported a 130x intraday spike on 1 Sep. The coin pays holders USDG rewards, and its site is a small Sherwood Forest game with an archery range.

cats.lore: In September 2026 Robinhood refreshed the Referrals tab in its app, and a tiny pixel cat appeared under a spotlight labelled 'You': a grey tabby in a green feathered cap and tunic, dressed like the outlaw of Sherwood himself. Fans spotted it within hours, and two days later Robinhood introduced it as 'your new favorite reason to refer'. The community named the little archer Robincat and built it a Sherwood Forest to live in, where visitors can wander the woods, tap a cat to say hello and try ten arrows at the Merry Marksman range.

cats.name: Raydium Cat
cats.catName: RayCat, a fan-made 'Raydium cat mascot' (illustrated tabby kitten)
cats.whoIsTheCat: Not a real cat: RayCat is a drawn brown tabby kitten presented as a fan-made 'Raydium cat mascot'. Its art shows it in a dark helmet with a blue scarf, or in a navy suit and cap punching the air. It arrived with the token on the StonkFun launchpad on 13 Aug 2026; its own site says it is not affiliated with Raydium.

virality.summary: RayCat is a launchpad-era character, not an old meme. It launched on StonkFun on 13 Aug 2026 in 'reward' mode: paired with RAY, with a 3% transfer fee paid to holders in RAY. Its site sums it up: 'Nine lives, one chart' and 'hold the cat, collect $RAY'. On 5 Sep 2026 Raydium announced that StonkFun launches now run on Raydium LaunchLab. StonkFun records RAYCAT's peak market cap at $16.1M, CoinGecko dates its ATH to 11 Sep 2026, and 8,364 wallets hold it today (GeckoTerminal).

GeckoTerminal holders: 8,364 (top 10 hold 26.3%). CoinGecko watchlists: 133. StonkFun peak market cap: $16,146,052. Raydium's LaunchLab post (2026-09-05): 44,674 views, 423 likes. cats.lore: RayCat is a brown tabby kitten who, in the words of its own website, 'showed up in a suit, punched the air, and started handing out rewards.' In one picture it bounces on its toes in a navy suit and cap, grinning with a fist in the air; in another it is a small soldier in a dark helmet and a blue scarf, watching a sunset with calm amber eyes. It moved onto Solana in August 2026 as a fan-made mascot for the Raydium crowd, with a motto that suits any cat: 'Nine lives, one chart.'
